analyses.estimateComment: Point estimate was assessed based on Miettinen \& Nurminen method stratified by predominant tumor histology (squamous vs non-squamous).
analyses.statisticalComment: One-sided p-value for testing. H0: difference in % = 0 versus H1: difference in % \> 0.

primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: ORR is defined as the proportion of participants who have a confirmed complete response (CR) or partial response (PR) per Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) v1.1 based on blinded independent central review (BICR).

groups.description: Participants received pembrolizumab 200 mg as an intravenous (IV) infusion, every three weeks (Q3W) starting on Day 1 of each cycle for up to 35 administrations in combination with epacadostat 100 mg orally, twice daily. Epacodostat administration was discontinued after the implementation of protocol amendment 05.
groups.title: Pembrolizumab + Epacadostat

groups.description: Participants received pembrolizumab 200 mg by IV infusion, Q3W starting on Day 1 of each cycle for up to 35 administrations in combination with matching placebo orally, twice daily. Placebo administration was discontinued after the implementation of protocol amendment 05.
groups.title: Pembrolizumab + Placebo

primaryOutcomeMeasures.populationDescription: ITT population consisted of all randomized participants.
primaryOutcomeMeasures.title: Objective Response Rate (ORR) of Pembrolizumab Plus Epacadostat Versus Pembrolizumab Plus Placebo
